name: Download PDF After Submit Form
author: Md. Shahinur Islam

sections.description:
Download PDF After Submit Form (DPASF) is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to protect and provide PDF files for download after users submit a form. Perfect for lead generation, gated content, and restricted file access.

With DPASF, you can:

  • Restrict PDF downloads until a form is submitted.
  • Collect user information for each download.
  • Customize popup designs with editable fields.
  • Use shortcodes anywhere on your site with ease.

This plugin offers the premium feature of ready popup design & provides quick access to beautiful all fields that can be edit in your popup easily.

Official Resources:
* 👉 Live Demo
* 👉 Pro Version
* 👉 Video Tutorial
* 👉 Installation Guide

Free Version Features

  • Protect and restrict PDF downloads.
  • Allow PDF download after form submission.
  • Two general popup form templates.
  • Collect and store user information when a PDF is downloaded.

Pro Version Features

Includes all free features plus:

  • Fully customizable popup designs.
  • Add, remove, or edit input fields.
  • Real-time updates to the form layout.
  • Premium support and faster assistance.

Note: Uninstall the free version before installing the Pro version.

Shortcodes

[formtodownload urlname="url" title="pdfname"]

Attributes:

  • urlname – The direct URL to your PDF (e.g., https://yoursite.com/file.pdf)
  • title – A unique name for the PDF (no spaces).

Support & Documentation

You can find and more detailed information about Download PDF after Submit Form on gitlab. If you were unable to find the answer to your question on the FAQ or in any of the documentation, you should check the support forum on WordPress.org. If you can’t locate any topics that pertain to your particular issue, post a new topic for it.

sections.installation:
1. Download and unzip the plugin. Upload the Download PDF After Submit Form folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Alternatively, go to WP Admin → Plugins → Add New → search Download PDF After Submit Form, then install and activate.
  4. Check our YouTube video guide for detailed instructions.

You will find the ‘Contact’ menu in your WordPress admin panel.

For basic usage, you can also have a look at the plugin website.
sections.faq:
Do you have questions or issues with Download PDF after Submit Form? Use these support channels appropriately.

What is DPASF?

DPASF (Download PDF After Submit Form) allows users to download a PDF after submitting a form on your WordPress site.

Is the free version fully functional?

Yes, the free version is fully functional. The Pro version adds advanced customization options.

Can I restrict any PDF?

Yes, you can protect and restrict any PDF file on your website.

Can I collect user information?

Yes, all user information submitted via the form can be stored and viewed in the plugin entries.

Is it mobile responsive?

Absolutely! DPASF is fully responsive and works on all devices.

How to install DPASF?

See the installation tab.

Is Free version fully free or there is a gap?

Yes, DPASF is fully free which is available on WordPress.org. This free version will always be free. It also has a pro version (already development) with additional features which you can purchase from our official website.

Can I collect all user info with DPASF?

Yes, You can and get all user info which you have findout view entries menu.

Is free version supported?

Yes, We provide full support on the WordPress.org forums. You can also post questions or bug reports through WP.org website. However, please note that, for free version’s support/replies, there can be delays upto 24-48 hours.

Pro version isn’t install?

Please remove or unistall free version then install pro version.
